items: Added a 'How it works' button next to Print that opens a modal explaining the tracker, loading real data, backups, and the AEDS Assistant
The 'Open in' default now switches to the upcoming semester about a month before the current one actually ends, instead of waiting for its first day

AEDS Assistant's course-progress context now lets its next-semester recommendations reflect what you've really completed, respects courses you count toward a different category than the catalog's default, and keeps suggesting planned (not-yet-taken) compulsory courses instead of hiding them

Added Load > Sync from StudIP: paste your StuMS achievements page to update grades on existing courses and add missing ones straight from the catalog, matched by module number (no login handling, nothing sent anywhere)
Added an AEDS Assistant chat bubble (bottom-right) that answers programme questions via a separate RAG chatbot; anonymous, and the only feature that talks to an external server
Added a Further modules category, scraped from the Stud.IP 'Further modules' section that was previously skipped
Further modules ECTS now count toward your completed total (the 120 ECTS degree requirement itself is unchanged)
Added a Next semester tab with two alternative course-selection suggestions for the upcoming semester
Graduation checklist now shows clearer status ticks (done / planned but not yet completed / missing) for ECTS categories and compulsory courses
The graduation path simulation no longer schedules the thesis or new courses earlier than what you've already planned
The 'not offered anymore' warning no longer applies to compulsory courses, since they run every semester
Added an anonymous course difficulty rating (1-5) for courses you've passed
Average difficulty and vote count are now shown when adding a course
You can change or remove your own difficulty rating at any time
Ratings are stored transparently in ratings.json in this repository
